scope: CPU data preparation design only; no running runtime, queue, TAKEOVER, or NPU state changed.

existing_train.allowed: Train data/operator engineering and later matched training; all windows remain in this source role.

existing_dev.allowed: Development diagnostics only. This cohort is neither independent calibration nor frozen test.

historical_unused_by_current_pilot.interpretation: Counts mean available prior Stage7 train/validation sources after historic-eval ID exclusion. They do not establish unused project history, independent calibration, or fresh test eligibility.

independent_calibration.purpose: Fit confidence calibration only after fixing the fidelity checkpoint and its training recipe; no training gradients to fidelity parameters.

frozen_test.purpose: Lock membership, target windows, recipes and metric policy before any model score; use once for final comparison, not threshold/recipe selection.

priority_source_audit_queue.reason: Passed old video sharpness heuristic but failed audio RMS or >8 kHz ratio gates. Video-only R_phi does not require these audio gates. This is not a claim of pristine source quality or never-trained history.
priority_source_audit_queue.next_action: Audit these 46 before expanding the arbitrary candidate scan; retain all prior 32 probe evidence.

original_deterministic_candidate_audit.selection: Ascending SHA256 over seed string with the actual source_id substituted; first 32 of 694 IDs outside recorded candidate lists and exclusion files. Exact locked IDs are in evidence.candidate_selection.
original_deterministic_candidate_audit.interpretation: All 32 read correctly, but only 2 passed old sharpness heuristic. Keep the locked audit queue and failures; do not relabel its membership as approved clean sources.

source_roles.shortage: There are currently zero approved independent calibration or frozen-test sources. Forty-six metadata candidates may not yield the desired 8 + 16 qualifying independent source groups. If fewer than 24 qualify, acquire/document additional sources rather than relabel existing dev, historic training, or previously tuned evaluation sources.
source_roles.upstream_pretraining: Unknown overlap with foundation-model pretraining is disclosed. Required project-level exclusion concerns this repository's training, calibration, validation, evaluation and tuning history, without claiming universal pretraining non-overlap.

candidate_approval_protocol.action: Join all historical source IDs, original video/group identifiers, original paths and available source hashes from evidence.history_inventory, historical_evaluations, exclusion files and prior candidate manifests; record match reasons. Source-group membership overrides window-level IDs.

Resolve the 46 candidates' literal-ID matches in bounded project logs/results and loader/manifest provenance. Harvest metadata is acquisition/quality filtering, not evidence of model training or model evaluation. Ambiguous model-use history prevents independent calibration/test assignment.

Compute full source SHA256, exact decoded-window target SHA256, dimensions, duration, timestamps and complete 96-frame readability for candidate sources only. Existing 32 file hashes may be reused only when file size/mtime identity agrees; do not hash all 778 raw files.

Review candidate reference quality and continuous-window validity using source pixels only, without looking at any restoration model scores. Reject preblur, heavy compression, extreme resampling, title-only/black/static failure windows, or clips unsuitable as a clean-reference proxy. Old band-ratio pass alone is insufficient. Record all reject reasons.

Check exact hashes, sampled-frame/perceptual matches and available original video/context grouping against current train/dev, historical train/eval cohorts and other candidates. A filename prefix/shard is not a semantic source group. Put known excerpts/reuploads/near duplicates into one group and one split.

Only after approval, deterministically rank eligible independent source groups with a published immutable split seed; assign first 8 to calibration and next 16 to frozen test, reserve the rest. No source/windows or connected group may cross train/calibration/dev/test.

Write a locked source registry with source/group hashes, history evidence, quality verdict, split and reason. If fewer than 24 independently eligible groups remain, publish the shortage and keep frozen test empty until resolved.

target_contract.caveat: The original recording can contain acquisition/compression artifacts. It is a shared clean-reference proxy, not a claim of physically pristine radiance.
target_contract.color: decoded RGB24, preserve and record source color metadata and actual decoder conversion behavior
target_contract.start_seconds: max(0, (ffprobe_duration_s - 96/24) / 2); require enough decodable frames, not metadata duration alone
target_contract.frame_selection: Record exact ffmpeg accurate input-seek + fps=24:round=near + centered crop arguments and all decoded timestamps; exact 96-frame count required.
target_contract.source_decode: Decode once per source/window and reuse one immutable target across every profile; emit observation profiles sequentially.
target_contract.geometry: The whole native clip remains HR and the whole SR clip remains x4 LR. No mid-clip geometry change.
target_contract.audio: No audio supervision is introduced. Missing/quiet/narrow-band audio does not invalidate a video-only reference.
hash_bindings: source group ID and split registry SHA256

GaussianBlur.implementation: OpenCV GaussianBlur on float32 RGB values in 0..255
GaussianBlur.sigma: Explicit per-frame HR-pixel sigma; LR sigma would require a different named operator
GaussianBlur.zero_sigma: bypass; never let sigma=0 select an implicit OpenCV sigma

noise.seed: uint64 from first 8 bytes, big-endian, SHA256('omni-mixed-v1|' + source_sha256 + '|' + window_key + '|' + noise_stream + '|' + zero_padded_frame_index)
noise.paired_streams: The two static operator-order profiles use identical sampled noise arrays. Native smooth and abrupt share the same unit-noise realization at each frame; only sigma schedule differs.
noise.identity: Seed is a deterministic recipe identifier and must not be supplied to blind model inputs.

quantization.order: At explicit operator boundaries only; native blur/noise ordering controls quantize once before codec. SR quantizes before Pillow resize and after LR noise; this extra boundary is disclosed.

bicubic_x4.implementation: Pillow Image.resize((W//4,H//4), Image.Resampling.BICUBIC) on uint8 RGB
bicubic_x4.not_claimed: This is the explicit synthetic degradation recipe, not an equivalence claim with PyTorch interpolation or a physical camera operator.

h264.scene_cut_policy: Disable automatic scene-cut keyframes for the primary continuous-content schedules; record actual keyframe indices in the receipt.
h264.crf_scope: Constant CRF per full clip in primary profiles. Listed per frame for a uniform parameter schema, not a per-frame encoder control.
h264.color_conversion: Record encoder/decoder color range/matrix and actual codec/libav build; RGB<->YUV conversion belongs to the observation degradation.

jpeg.interpretation: Independent image coding only; not a substitute for inter-frame video compression.

software_snapshot.system_ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 4.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2019 the FFmpeg developers
software_snapshot.caveat: Sparse probes used system ffmpeg 4.2. New codec observations must record their actual PyAV/libx264 build separately.

operator_contract.version_rule: Pin and record the actual converter environment and codec build; the system FFmpeg sparse-read probes and PyAV encoder use different libav versions. Byte reproducibility is promised only for the recorded build/settings and verified replay.
operator_contract.hidden_parameters: Schedules/severity/order are logged for audit and stratified evaluation only. They are not R_phi blind model conditions.
operator_contract.mixed_task_schema: mixed_native is a new data profile family, not silently mapped to one of the current four single-task one-hots. A future versioned loader must explicitly support its blind route; do not feed these profiles into today's frozen four-task runtime unchanged.

profiles.content_requirement: A single continuous source window; flag/exclude natural content cuts from this primary transition profile.

profiles.interpretation: Frame-independent JPEG quality changes, not temporally predictive H264 quality variation.

scene_cut_control.composition: 48 consecutive frames from source A followed by 48 from source B; both source groups must already belong to the same split.
scene_cut_control.source_provenance: Both original file hashes, both source IDs/group IDs, both source windows and the joint target hash are mandatory.
scene_cut_control.model_history: Carry causal state by default. An optional explicit oracle-reset diagnostic is reported separately and never used as the primary blind result.
scene_cut_control.metric_policy: Invalidate cross-cut optical-flow pair 47->48 with explicit support counts; report post-cut recovery separately from degradation-transition adaptation.
scene_cut_control.natural_cuts: Record natural content cuts separately. Primary continuous-content profiles must use cut-free approved windows, or publish per-cut strata rather than misclassifying a scene cut as a degradation transition.

optional_codec_segment_control.description: A future H264 CRF20->35 experiment encoded as independent 48-frame segments is a codec-reset confound, not a pure per-frame CRF schedule.
optional_codec_segment_control.requirement: Label segment/reset boundaries and actual keyframes separately; exclude it from the primary smooth/abrupt no-reset comparison.

execution_ladder.output: Referenced inventory evidence; no dataset promotion.

execution_ladder.action: Audit priority 46 metadata candidates and produce the source registry; do not assign frozen roles before approval.
Implement the new operator schema in an isolated file/config. Existing materialize_omni_pilot.py v1 supports four single tasks only and does not execute this plan.

checks: Full decode exact length and timestamps
Replay observations twice with identical pixel hashes
Static order controls share sampled noise arrays
No unintended H264 reset at frame48

execution_ladder.action: Only after smoke, materialize 2 existing train + 2 existing dev sources with the same pinned profiles. These remain engineering train/dev, never independent calibration/test.
execution_ladder.scene_cut_control: At most one within-train pair and one within-dev pair; no cross-split source concatenation.

execution_ladder.action: Review data/operator and evaluation receipts before larger materialization or any new NPU training. Keep current stage2 runs and their recipes untouched.

resource_limits.implementation_requirement: Keep clean uint8 once and one observation at a time; float intermediates at frame granularity. Use temp files/streaming decode rather than retaining all six RGB observation clips. Measure peak RSS in single-source smoke; stop and reduce buffering if budget exceeded.

evaluation_contract.scope: 96-frame transition experiment, not a long-video drift benchmark
evaluation_contract.sampling: All 96 frames with frame_stride=1 for candidate evaluation; stride4 results can screen cost but cannot establish adjacent-frame flicker.
evaluation_contract.pairing: Same source/window/target and identical parameter schedule/seed for every method; aggregate per source, not as independent frames/windows.
controls: raw observation or explicitly named SR bicubic guide
later matched mixed-data checkpoint only after a separate training recipe review
evaluation_contract.temporal_support: Record evaluated adjacent pairs, valid flow pixel support, excluded content cuts and whether reported flow/warp error uses GT or prediction. A metric reduction alone does not certify flicker absence.
evaluation_contract.calibration: Fit/calibrate only on an approved independent calibration cohort after fidelity parameters are fixed; current 8 dev cannot be renamed to fulfill this requirement.
evaluation_contract.frozen_test: Keep empty until the 16 source-group cohort and all metric/recipe policy are locked. No fallback to any historical train/val/eval source.
evaluation_contract.training_factor_control: Do not combine operator-order, time-varying schedule, architecture, guard weight, and confidence recipe changes into one claimed structural ablation. This plan prepares matched data controls; a separate minimal training matrix must name the one factor changed.

acceptance.success_next_step: One existing-train-source CPU smoke satisfies all receipt/replay/geometry/length checks, while candidate source audit independently determines whether 8 calibration + 16 test groups can be locked.
